name: the Vell
description: The drifted: humans, many generations removed from a colony that lost an earlier run. Tall, dark-eyed, low tech, with an oral tradition of star-songs. Wary of Accord: they have seen your kind fall.
contactText: Smoke from a camp: stilt huts around a fire, and people. Tall, thin, human, though nothing in the archive matches them. They have seen us. They watch, and they do not run.
approachText: The drone sets down at the edge of the firelight and waits. After a long while an elder with a hoop of chimes walks out to look at it. No one raises a weapon.
avoidText: We keep our distance. Their fire burns on through the night.
driveText: They take what they can carry and walk out of the region. The fire is left to die.
uneasyText: The Vell are uneasy. Our buildings stand on their land.
trustText: The song-keeper sings for the drone, and the colony's translators catch most of it: "They came like you. They grew like you. Their guardian burned them." The Vell will send runners when predators move.
leaveText: The Vell have abandoned their camp.
